notes.text:
****Huge release for the Neptunia Rebirth 3 Archipelago World****

Nep RB3 APWorld update:

- Quests are now added, please update to the latest Mod version from BlackSoulKnight for quests to function properly
- All quests are available by default, they currently work in-logic through Universal Tracker (Currently no in Poptracker)
- New Yaml Option regarding quests
- Updated incorrect region requirements for a few dungeons
